utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Sunday at the community center works, and the gate drop-off will help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll keep an eye out for small useful bits and drop them by your gate. And if Leo still needs hands, I can help sort donations or carry supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would mean a lot, Oren. I’ll let you know if Leo needs the extra hands, and thank you for keeping an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check the wiring list and see what we still need. Then we can fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — that’ll help a lot. I’m checking the community hall first, then the corner garden shed, and the repair drive is Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll check the wiring list and note anything missing. Then we can compare it with what you already have.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, Ira and Oren are helping, Rosa’s organizing it, and Gus can help load things up. I’m a bit tied up, but I can pitch in if needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Bo. I’ll make a simple list and ask around at drop-off for anything else that needs fixing, and we’ll keep that Saturday 9 to 12 window in mind.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — keep it simple, and if anything else comes up, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—once Tess tells me what’s still needed, I can bring a couple bins and help load everything up. We’ll make sure nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking what we already have and what’s still missing for the repair drive. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got the list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Cleo—just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll see what tools or bins I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s make the list first, then we can decide what gets fixed today and what can wait.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works for me — I’ll make the supply list and check in with the tool folks today, then we can sort what’s urgent.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that keeps it tidy. Once the list is set, we can sort the urgent repairs from the ones that can wait.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Gus said he can lend a few tools and bring a couple bins to help load things up. Cleo’s checking what we already have and what we still need, and Oren and Ira are helping too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s a big help. If Leo’s checking the wiring list, I’d feel better once we know what’s off so we can plan the pickups and repairs without running short.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, once Cleo finishes sorting what’s missing, we’ll know exactly what to pick up and fix. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear what’s off the wiring list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive. If you spot any location updates, let me know and I’ll pass them along too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I’m tracking the locations closely. I’ll note the community hall first, then the corner garden shed, and send you any updates.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep folks posted as soon as you send updates. Thanks for staying on top of the locations, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — that really helps with the repair drive. I’ll ask around at the drive to see where help’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep the volunteers and supplies lined up. I’ll wait for Leo’s wiring check before I move ahead.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll check in at the drive and see where I can help most.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll start the list and jot down the tools we already have. Gus can lend a few, and I’ll note the bins too while we wait for Tess’s update on what else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check the supplies and note anything we’re still missing for the repair drive. If I spot gaps, I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — that’ll help. I’ll keep track of the bins and wait for Tess’s update on the rest.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll drop by the repair drive and mention it to a few neighbors. I’ll also gather the remaining repair tasks and pass them along to Jules.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, I’ll spread the word around the block and keep Quinn posted on who’s coming.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll do my part at the repair drive and keep looping in neighbors. I’ll send Jules the remaining tasks once I’ve got them together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Leo — send it over when you can. I’ll keep the tools ready and be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — I can loop Pia in with Gus about the tools, and Rey’s free most afternoons if you need extra hands for pickups or repairs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — are donations still needed for the repair drive? I can help spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll check around and see if donations are still needed for the repair drive, and where help is needed most. I’ll let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell. If you hear where help is most needed, let me know right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear where they still need help most.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can check with Gus about those tools for Pia, and I’ll ask Vik to send me the remaining repair tasks. Rey’s free most afternoons too, so I can help line up pickups or repairs.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so the repair drive is definitely still on, right? And Sam’s still helping with it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, it’s still on, and Sam is still helping too. I’m just lining up the tools, tasks, and pickups so we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: You got it — I’ll swing by, repeat the plan, and bring a few tools to help out for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — that helps a lot. If you can also keep the pickup flexible, I’ll try to line up the rest around it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly still need a few more tools and extra hands—wrenches, screwdrivers, and maybe a drill if you’ve got one. If you can swing by, we could use you too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check the supplies and jot down anything we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—Rosa’s organizing it, and Ira’s helping too. Gus can load things up and bring a couple bins if needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll take a look at the supplies and let you know what’s still missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll check around and see where help is needed most, then let Mina know if donations are still needed. If I hear anything else at drop-off, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell — I’ll keep you posted as soon as I have the time and place, and I’ll point folks to the sign-up sheet too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll ask around and keep an ear out at drop-off, then update Mina if donations are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. Opal’s watching the locations, so we should be set there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep an eye out for small useful things and drop them by Uli’s gate.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll get the invitation around fast, and if I hear of anyone with extra supplies, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll note community hall first, then the corner garden shed. That should keep the repair drive locations clear.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks—I'll make a simple list and ask around at drop-off for anything else that needs fixing. I can also help spread the word there, and Noah can check in at the drive about where help’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll start the list with the tools we already have and note the bins, then wait for Tess’s update on what else we still need. Gus can lend a few tools, and Oren can sort donations or help carry supplies.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help once Noah’s got the rundown. Just let me know what still needs doing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Cleo’s checking the supplies and will tell us what’s missing, so that should help. I really appreciate her keeping an eye on it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll wait for Cleo’s update, then I can jump in on whatever’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. Sunday at the community center still works, and I appreciate you mentioning it to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll stop by Sunday and tell a few neighbors. I’ll also mention the gate drop-off for small useful items.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Vik. That means a lot to me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—Tess can let me know what’s still needed, and I can bring a couple bins and a few tools. I’ll help load everything up so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—Bo, Sam, and Opal are all helping too. Jules is sharing the details and rounding folks up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — I’ll check what we already have and list anything we’re still missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll follow up with Vik and Pia for the repair drive. Oren can sort donations or help carry supplies if needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — that’s helpful. I’ll keep things moving here and make sure the repair drive stays coordinated.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. I’ll check in with Vik and Pia and let you know what they can take on.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — let’s wait for Cleo’s update and see what’s still missing before we make a firm plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that makes sense — Cleo can sort out what we’ve already got and what we still need. In the meantime, Gus can bring the bins and a few tools, and Oren and Ira are pitching in too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, that covers it—I’ll keep the locations straight and watch for any updates at the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center. I’m checking the community hall first, then the corner garden shed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll wait on your update about donations, and I can help point people to where it’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Mina — I’ll update you on the donations as soon as I check the hall and shed. With Bo and Sam helping, we should be in good shape for Sunday.
